description: Search the web and get the results, in ONE payment. Ghost runs the search on its own provider account and returns the actual results — organic hits with title, url and snippet, plus answer box, knowledge panel, related questions — normalised into one shape. It fails over from Serping to Serper, so one dead upstream costs a retry. Payment settles before the search runs; if no upstream delivers, the fee becomes Ghost service credit, not an on-chain refund. The DSSE receipt is Ghost's signature over your query, the returned URLs and the provider that served them. It proves what Ghost returned and from which upstream; it does not verify that the results are accurate, complete or current. Search only: Ghost does not fetch the pages. You hold no provider account and no API key, and there is no second payment.

inputSchema.description:
A Verified Web Search request. Only `query` is required; `results`, `country`
and `language` shape the search. One payment covers the whole call.

payment_signature.description: x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit it to receive the payment terms; call again with it to run the tool.
